articles.sourceExcerpt: Rectifying Geometric Misalignment: Online Source-Free Adaptation for Class-Imbalanced EEG Shiwen Chu 1,2, Shanglin Li 1,3, Motoaki Kawanabe 1,2, Reinmar Kobler 1 1Advanced Telecommunications Research Institute International, 2-2-2 Hikaridai Seika-cho, Soraku-gun, Kyoto, Japan 2Nara Institute of Science and Technology, 8916-5 Takayama-cho, Ikoma, Nara, Japan 3BIFOLD – Berlin Institute for the F oundations of Learning and Data, 10587 Berlin, Germany kawanabe@atr.jp, kobler.reinmar@gmail.com Abstract—Electroencephalography (EEG) based Brain- Computer Interfaces (BCIs) often require unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) to generalize across subjects and sessions. While Riemannian alignment methods like the Riemannian Centering Transformation (RCT) are effective for handling covariate shifts, they implicitly assume balanced class priors. However, in realistic online BCI scenarios, the label distributions vary dynamically (label shift), causing standard alignment techniques to geometrically misalign the target data distributions.

articles.title: NeuroPB: Scaling Neural Decoding with Pretrained Behavioral Representations
articles.selectionReason: Open full-text paper; topic brain_computer_interface; quality signal passed; application scenario is clear.

paperCard.problem: 脑机接口要解码连续运动轨迹，但神经数据难采集、规模小、不同时间/人/任务差异大，导致现有解码器泛化差。
paperCard.method: 先用大量行为轨迹（猴子的或机器人的）预训练一个运动编码器，得到结构化的行为表征空间；再用少量成对的神经-行为数据，通过对比学习把神经活动映射到这个空间；最后用一个轻量解码器从神经表征还原出运动轨迹。
paperCard.difference: 以前的方法主要靠大规模神经数据预训练或端到端直接映射，受限于神经数据稀缺；NeuroPB反其道而行，利用容易大规模获取的行为数据来提供先验，不再依赖海量神经数据。
paperCard.innovation: 创新点在于把行为预训练作为神经解码的可扩展数据源，并证明机器人大规模轨迹可以替代生物数据用于预训练，还展示了数据规模越大解码效果越好。
paperCard.implementation: 分为三步：1）用掩码轨迹重建预训练Transformer运动编码器，可采用猴子轨迹、规模匹配的机器人轨迹或大规模LIBERO-100机器人轨迹；2）冻结该编码器，用CLIP风格的对称对比损失对齐神经编码器和行为表征；3）将对齐后的神经表征输入轻量运动解码器重建轨迹。论文还对比了不同预训练数据来源和规模的影响。
paperCard.applications: 可用于脑机接口控制假肢、机器人、电脑光标等，尤其适合需要跨会话、跨受试者泛化且标定数据少的场景。
technicalTerms: 神经解码：从大脑神经信号中还原出意图或动作。
行为表征：把运动轨迹转换成一种向量表示，捕捉运动的结构特征。
对比学习：让匹配的神经和行为样本在向量空间中靠近，不匹配的远离。
掩码轨迹重建：遮住轨迹的一部分，让模型根据剩余部分预测被遮住的坐标，从而学习运动规律。
Transformer：一种基于注意力机制的神经网络结构，善于处理序列数据。
R²：决定系数，用来衡量解码轨迹与实际轨迹的拟合程度，越接近1越好。

articles.highlight: 行为预训练持续提升轨迹解码效果，在中心外出任务上R²提高11%，随机目标任务上提高8%。
articles.summary: 本文提出NeuroPB框架，利用大规模行为数据（包括猴子和机器人轨迹）预训练行为表征，再通过对比学习将神经活动对齐到该表征空间，从而在神经数据有限时更高效地解码连续运动轨迹。该研究还发现，用机器人轨迹预训练也能达到与用猴子轨迹预训练相当的效果，说明跨实体存在可迁移的运动结构。
articles.failureAnalysis: 主要局限是神经数据仍需要成对的行为数据来对齐，且实验仅在猕猴数据集上验证，尚未看到在人类脑机接口数据上的直接证据。
articles.sourceExcerpt: NeuroPB: Scaling Neural Decoding with Pretrained Behavioral Representations Luyao Jin1, Yonghao Song2, Huan Zhao1, Vincent C. Cheung3, Wei-Hsin Liao1∗ 1Department of Mechanical and Automation Engineering, The Chinese University of Hong Kong 2Department of Biomedical Engineering, School of Medicine, Tsinghua University 3School of Biomedical Sciences, The Chinese University of Hong Kong lyjin@link.cuhk.edu.hk, whliao@cuhk.edu.hk Abstract Decoding continuous motor trajectories from neural activity isessentialfordevelopingpracticalbrain–computerinterfaces (BCIs). However, current neural decoders are constrained by the limited scale and heterogeneity of neural recordings.

en.highlight: Behavioral pretraining improves trajectory decoding, increasing R2 by 11% on center-out and 8% on random-target tasks.
en.summary: This paper proposes NeuroPB, a framework that pretrains behavioral representations on large-scale behavioral data (monkey or robotic trajectories) and aligns neural activity to them via contrastive learning, enabling efficient decoding of continuous movement under limited neural data. It also shows that robotic pretraining works as well as monkey pretraining, suggesting transferable motor structure across embodiments.
en.failureAnalysis: The main limitation is that paired neural-behavioral data are still required for alignment, and experiments are only on macaque datasets, with no direct evidence on human BCI data.
en.title: NeuroPB: Scaling Neural Decoding with Pretrained Behavioral Representations

paperCard.problem: BCIs need to decode continuous motor trajectories, but neural data are scarce, heterogeneous across sessions/subjects/tasks, and existing decoders generalize poorly.
paperCard.method: Pretrain a motor encoder on large-scale behavioral trajectories (monkey or robot) to get a structured behavioral representation space; then use limited paired neural-behavioral data to align neural activity into that space via contrastive learning; finally reconstruct movement with a lightweight decoder.
paperCard.difference: Prior methods rely on large neural datasets or direct end-to-end mapping, limited by neural data scarcity; NeuroPB instead uses easily scalable behavioral data to provide priors.
paperCard.innovation: The innovation is using behavioral pretraining as a scalable data source for neural decoding, showing robotic trajectories can substitute biological ones, and that larger behavioral data scales improve decoding.
paperCard.implementation: Three stages: 1) pretrain a Transformer motor encoder via masked trajectory reconstruction on monkey or robotic trajectories; 2) freeze it and align neural encoder outputs to behavioral representations with a CLIP-style symmetric contrastive loss; 3) decode movements from aligned neural representations. It compares different pretraining sources and scales.
paperCard.applications: BCI control of prosthetics, robots, computer cursors, especially where calibration data are limited and cross-session/subject generalization is needed.
technicalTerms: neural decoding: inferring intent or movement from brain signals.
behavioral representation: a vector embedding capturing movement structure.
contrastive learning: pulling matched neural-behavioral pairs closer while pushing mismatched pairs apart.
masked trajectory reconstruction: predicting masked positions from observed ones to learn movement patterns.
Transformer: an attention-based neural architecture good at sequence data.
R2: coefficient of determination, measuring how well decoded trajectories match actual ones.
